title: Maya / Claude + Higgsfield UGC Automation
caption:
Most brands still think UGC means hiring creators, shipping product, and waiting weeks for content. It doesn't anymore.

Here's the system: Claude + Higgsfield, running together, producing unlimited UGC content — fully automated, under $50 a month.

The 5 steps (they're all on the slides):

1. Start with an AI avatar — a new influencer or a clone of you
2. Create the character — one consistent face, locked forever
3. Build the persona — Claude defines the niche, voice and content
4. Connect Claude to Higgsfield — Claude writes, Higgsfield generates
5. Ship it every day — fresh content on autopilot

No filming. No creators. No burnout. One person running a whole content brand.

Comment UGC and I'll send you the exact workflow to set it up.

— maya
